title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-12T19:09:20.493Z
Resolved: 2026-10-12T22:20:15.859Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-12T22:20:15.859Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-12T19:39:43.166Z: monitoring - A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
- 2026-10-12T19:09:20.633Z: investigating - Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected. 

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

incident.name: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues

incident_updates.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected. 

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

components.description: Cloudflare Workers provides a serverless execution environment that allows you to create new applications or augment existing ones without configuring or maintaining infrastructure
